item.title: Chevrolet Pickup-Style Sofa at No Reserve
item.description: This sofa was built by the seller's spouse and features a rear bed section and a tailgate from a 1964 Chevrolet pickup. It has orange-painted bodywork and a seat cushion upholstered in white vinyl. This Chevy pickup-style sofa is now offered at no reserve in Covington, Tennessee.

item.title: 40k-Mile 1999 BMW M3 Convertible 5-Speed
item.description: This 1999 BMW M3 convertible was initially delivered to Camelback BMW of Phoenix, Arizona, and was purchased new by the seller's friend. The car was acquired by the seller in 2001 and has since been driven 20k of the 40k miles indicated. It is powered by a 3.2-liter inline-six paired with a five-speed manual transmission and is finished in Titanium Silver Metallic over gray Nappa leather upholstery. item.title: Modified 1951 Muntz Jet
item.description: This 1951 Muntz Jet is one of a reported 198 examples produced between 1949 and 1954. It was refurbished and modified under previous ownership with the installation of a 350ci V8, a 700R4 four-speed automatic transmission, a Ford 9" rear end, and power-assisted four-wheel ventilated disc brakes. item.title: 2006 Chevrolet Trailblazer SS at No Reserve
item.description: This 2006 Chevrolet Trailblazer SS is an all-wheel-drive example that was registered in Nevada from new until its 2025 acquisition by the selling dealer, and it now indicates 52k miles. item.title: 1998 Honda Acty Van SDX 4WD 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1998 Honda Acty SDX is a right-hand-drive van that was imported to the US following the selling dealer's acquisition in 2025, and it shows 64k kilometers (~39k miles). Power is provided by a 656cc inline-three linked with a five-speed manual transaxle and a Real Time four-wheel-drive system. item.description: This 2005 Lotus Elise has 21k miles following registration history in Kentucky, Texas, and Pennsylvania. item.title: Double-Sided Porcelain Yacco Motor Oil and Total Gasoline Signs at No Reserve
item.description: These double-sided porcelain Yacco Motor Oil and Total Gasoline signs were acquired by the selling dealer in 2025 in France and subsequently imported into the US. Both signs are made of metal, have pre-drilled mounting holes, and multi-colored faces. The Yacco sign measures 39.5" across, while the Total sign measures 34.75" wide. This pair of French porcelain oil signs is now offered at no reserve in Salem, Oregon.
